architecture: 6-Agent Closed-Loop Windows, PowerShell & Batch Engineering Pod (3-Layer Self-Learning Memory + Hard 500-Line Read Ceiling + Dual-Engine PS 5.1/PS 7 & XAML AST/Graphify Graph + SHA256 Receipt + Per-Lane Telemetry + 12-Lesson Cap)

ast_and_graphify_slicing_policy.rule: WL-007 & WL-011: No agent may ever invoke read_file without StartLine/EndLine on any file > 500 lines (including ast-line-graph.json) or read > 500 lines in a single call. Agents read .agents/state/ast-receipt-latest.json (<30 lines, sha256-bound) or run Get-PsAstGraph.ps1 -Query.

ambiguity_and_anti_reiteration_policy.rule: WL-008: When user requirements are ambiguous or underspecified, halt before Wave 2 implementation and ask EXACTLY 3 targeted clarifying questions (each with a '(Recommended)' best-practice default). Once implementation starts, never repeat passing checks, never re-read untouched lines, and terminate immediately when Gate 1/2 >= 95% (max 1 delta retry on failure).

variables.I_reg_ad_sec_exe: 1 ONLY if task mutates Windows Registry, Active Directory, Credential Manager/DPAPI, Firewall/ACL, or packaging pipeline security; routine PowerShell logic, WPF [xml] XAML layout edits, and build_exe.ps1 recompiles score 0 (guarded in Lane 1 by 0-token Get-PsAstGraph.ps1 + build_exe.ps1 pre-flight checks)

dynamic_auto_promotion.trigger: Any task with I_reg_ad_sec_exe == 1 and F >= 1 scores C >= 4 and routes directly to LANE_2_STANDARD_POD. If windows-system-engineer in Lane 1 discovers F > 2 or I_reg_ad_sec_exe == 1, halt before editing and return PROMOTE_TO_LANE_2.

LANE_1_EXPRESS.workflow: chief-of-staff (asks 3 questions if ambiguous; runs Get-PsAstGraph.ps1 -Query if target file > 500 lines) -> windows-system-engineer (gemini-3.8-flash High: reads/edits <=500-line AST slice + WL-001..012 + 1s Dual-Engine Get-PsAstGraph.ps1 receipt) -> append 1 line to .agents/state/task-history.jsonl & update per-lane counters in session-ledger.json.
LANE_1_EXPRESS.gate_policy: Inline 1s Dual-Engine PS 5.1/PS 7 + XAML + SHA256 AST receipt (.agents/state/ast-receipt-latest.json)

LANE_2_STANDARD_POD.workflow: W1: product-engineer (3-question /grill-me if in doubt + Signature Contract + AST line-range write_locks[] <= 500 lines) -> W2: windows-system-engineer (<=500-line slice edit via edit_file + 6-field JSON Handoff Envelope with sha256-bound ast_receipt, touched_ranges, & telemetry) -> W3: Parallel Gate 1 (qa-qc-security-auditor verifies .agents/state/ast-receipt-latest.json in 0ms, audits only touched_ranges <= 500 lines) || Gate 2 (ui-ux-tester verifies xaml_control_check + Pester smoke tests + GUI slices) -> W4: update <45-line session-ledger.json + append task-history.jsonl + Self-Learning WL-xxx check + Cumulative Cost Rollup.
LANE_2_STANDARD_POD.gate_policy: Gate 1 + Gate 2 (>= 95% confidence required; immediate exit on PASS, max 1 delta retry on FAIL)

LANE_3_ENTERPRISE_SUITE.workflow: W1: product-engineer -> W2: windows-system-engineer -> W3: Parallel Gate 1 || Gate 2 -> W4: tech-writer (gemini-3.8-flash Low: README + Get-Help + Admin Guide via <=500-line AST slices) + chief-of-staff sign-off.
LANE_3_ENTERPRISE_SUITE.gate_policy: Full Dual-Gate + Documentation & Packaging Sign-Off (>= 95% confidence; immediate exit on PASS)

subagent_report_suppression_policy.rule: All 5 specialist subagents (subagent: true) MUST NEVER output the Markdown '### 📋 Response Details & Cost Audit' block inside their subagent sessions. They return compact token metrics in the 'telemetry' field of their 6-field JSON Handoff Envelope so chief-of-staff renders one unified Cumulative Subagent & Session Cost Audit report.

owns: Per-lane task-history.jsonl & Cumulative Cost Audit rollup
<=500-line surgical AST slice reading & editing via edit_file (WL-009)
1s Dual-Engine PS 5.1/PS 7 + XAML + SHA256 Get-PsAstGraph.ps1 receipt generation

Self-learning WL-xxx lesson logging on defect

lessons_learned.rule: Never run unguarded Get-ChildItem -Recurse or raw -Path on Windows directories or network shares. Always use -LiteralPath (to handle '[' and ']' in filenames) and filter out [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint to prevent Windows junction/symlink infinite loops.

Any PowerShell script using System.Windows.Forms or PresentationFramework MUST enforce [System.STAThread] / -sta relaunch guards before initializing controls, and offload disk/network I/O (rclone, robocopy, directory scans) to a RunspacePool or background job using [hashtable]::Synchronized(@{}) so the GUI never freezes.

Every .bat or .cmd script MUST begin with '@echo off' and 'setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion', wrap all file/directory variables in double quotes ("%~dp0", "%TARGET%"), check '%ERRORLEVEL%' after external commands, and terminate with 'exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%' (never bare 'exit').

Resolve script base directories using [System.AppDomain]::CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory with $PSScriptRoot fallback so ps2exe compiled binaries locate adjacent files reliably, and ALWAYS pass -iconFile ps_deploy.ico when packaging ps_deploy.ps1 into ps_deploy.exe via build_exe.ps1. Run external CLIs in GUI apps via ProcessStartInfo with CreateNoWindow=$true and explicit $LASTEXITCODE checks.

Never hardcode plaintext credentials or API keys in .ps1, .bat, or .reg files; use Windows DPAPI (ConvertTo-SecureString / Export-Clixml) or Microsoft.PowerShell.SecretManagement. All destructive file, Registry, Service, or Active Directory mutations MUST declare [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess=$true)].

Subagents (subagent: true) must never render the Markdown '### 📋 Response Details & Cost Audit' footer inside sub-sessions. They return a 15-token 'telemetry' object in their 6-field JSON Handoff Envelope for single-pass rollup by chief-of-staff.

Never call read_file without StartLine/EndLine on any file over 500 lines (including ast-line-graph.json), and never read a slice where (EndLine - StartLine + 1) > 500. For any .ps1/.psm1/.bat/.cmd file > 500 lines, run Get-PsAstGraph.ps1 -Query first (<100ms, 0 LLM tokens) and operate strictly on <=500-line AST slices across all waves.

When in doubt or facing ambiguous requirements, halt before Wave 2 and ask the user EXACTLY 3 clarifying questions (each with a '(Recommended)' best-practice default). Never repeat passing gates, never re-read untouched lines, and cap remediation at 1 targeted delta retry.

Never use Write-Output inside PowerShell helper functions that return source code strings (which pollutes the return array with log strings), and always validate ps2exe targets with Windows PowerShell 5.1 Parser::ParseFile in addition to PowerShell 7 AST parsing.
Never duplicate AGENTS.md content inside .agents/rules/ or repeat identical WL-xxx prose across agent manifests and skills. Each rule lives in one canonical file and is referenced by ID.

Gate 1 and Gate 2 must never read the full .agents/state/ast-line-graph.json cache via read_file. Always verify the <30-line .agents/state/ast-receipt-latest.json (containing file sha256, git-diff touched_ranges, xaml_control_check, and security_and_wl_audit) and fail Gate 1 if gci_missing_literalpath_lines or invoke_expression_lines is non-empty.

Record 1 compact JSONL line per completed task across all lanes (L1, L2, L3) in .agents/state/task-history.jsonl (capped at 500 lines), maintain per-lane counters in <45-line .agents/state/session-ledger.json, and cap lessons_learned[] at max_lessons: 12 by promoting deterministic checks into Get-PsAstGraph.ps1.
